subject: design/local-work-tracker-v2
statement: identifiers are sequential positive integers allocated by **atomic exclusive-create**. To create, the store attempts `open(items/<n>.md, O_CREAT|O_EXCL)` starting at the highest-known id + 1 and incrementing on `EEXIST` until the create wins; the winning exclusive create *is* the allocation. No counter file, no lock, first-writer-wins — collision-free and never-reused under concurrent local processes (PRD UB-5), and human-referenceable (`#1`, `#2`, …) as FR-1 requires. Ids need not be dense; a gap (from a failed create) is legal and never reused. This assumes local POSIX `O_EXCL` semantics; networked filesystems are out of scope (R2).
